title: Hilaria Baldwin ridiculed for her dance moves after another contestant voted off DWTS - NewsBreak
text:
By Kathleen O'Boyle ,
1 hours ago
Fans are questioning Hilaria Baldwin's place on Dancing with the Stars after a surprising elimination left some feeling she should have gone home instead.
Following the episode, Baldwin uploaded a video to Instagram showing her and husband Alec Baldwin dancing to "Shake It To The Max" by Ghanaian singer Molly and Jamaican producer Silent Addy.
In the clip, the couple raised their arms, flapped them back and forth, and leaned over while wiggling their hips. Toward the end of the video, the DWTS contestant laughed at her husband's attempts to keep up with the routine. The yoga instructor captioned the post, "Alec tried our routine."
While some followers found the lighthearted clip amusing, others didn't hold back criticism. Several fans responded with "No" gifs or left comments such as "Yikes." One commenter wrote, "I've actually been open to her, even with her dance history, but this is off putting to me."
On Reddit, another viewer shared: "I feel like she's not good enough to look like a pro and not interesting enough to look like a star - an awkward middle ground." Someone else claimed, "I think she wrote this comment herself on a burner. I know people here wanted to give her the benefit of the doubt, but she really doesn't seem like a nice person and I don't think she deserves it."
Others criticized Baldwin for involving her family in her posts. "She's also posting videos of her kids for sympathy talking about how they were crying when she was last but then realized she had 'the most votes,'" one user said.
Another added, "Here we go, she will blame everyone but herself. Even if she was in second place she would do this, she is ungrateful and cruel."
The wife of Alec Baldwin has faced a shaky run on DWTS with her professional partner, Gleb Savchenko.

On X, one fan wrote, "Lauren over Hilaria?!??!?! This is rigged." Another added, "LAUREN SHOULD NOT BE GOING HOME." A third viewer declared, "I'm about to stop watching after they saved Hilaria over Lauren."
